description: List an item's QA notes. The typed QA notes on a queue item, newest first (max 200) — narrowing, clarification, verification and correction notes, each with its author and time. They are separate from the comment thread: read these to learn the CURRENT QA state of a ticket (what remains failing, what …

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

kind.description: What a QA note is — `narrowing` (only part of the bug still fails), `clarification` (changes what "fixed" means), `verification` (a pass/fail verdict on a fix) or `correction` (withdraws an earlier framing).

name: ops_qa_notes_list
